note: Reel 17: Butter Chicken's Two Inventors. Butter chicken is credited to Kundan Lal: Kundan Lal Gujral (c.1902-1997) or Kundan Lal Jaggi (1924-2018), friends and partners from Peshawar who, after Partition, ran Moti Mahal in Daryaganj, Delhi (Nehru among its diners: Reuters 2024). Their families now run rival chains (Moti Mahal Delux; Daryaganj), and since January 2024 they have been in the Delhi High Court (Rupa Gujral & Ors v Daryaganj Hospitality, CS(COMM) 26/2024; a 2,752-page suit: NPR, Reuters). The Gujrals say Gujral made it in Peshawar to save leftover tandoori chicken in a gravy for the next day; the Jaggis say Jaggi made it in Delhi to stretch a few pieces for late guests (NPR 2024). On 23 Sep 2026 the hearing was deferred to 3 Dec 2026 (Delhi HC order). Facts: docs/research.md. Kokoro af_heart, speed 1.0. Indian names are planned by hand (memory: indian-word-pronunciation): कुंदन लाल [kʊndən laːl] 'KOON-dun LAAL', गुजराल [ɡʊdʒraːl] 'goo-JRAAL', जग्गी [dʒəɡːiː] 'JUG-gee', पेशावर [peːʃaːʋər] 'pay-SHAA-war', मोती महल [moːtiː mɛɦɛl] 'MO-tee MEH-hel', नेहरू [neːɦruː] 'NAY-roo'. The b lines try the other plan, the c lines Kokoro's own (the plain spelling), for the ears to judge. Round 1 (run 41227181066): Kundan Lal plan A was heard 'k ʌ n d ə n l ɑː l' and written 'Kundan Lal' by large-v3 (plain: 'Cunden Lau'); Jaggi 'dʒ ʌ ɡ i'; Moti Mahal and Nehru right with their plans (plain: 'Modi Mahal', 'Nero'). Gujral lost its j in the dʒɹ cluster ('ɡ ə d ɹ ɑː l', small.en 'Gedral'), the plural 'Gujrals' became 'good draws', Peshawar glided to 'pay-SHOW-er' ('p eɪ ʃ aʊ ɚ', once 'pay shower'), 'certain.' was clipped to 'cert' at the line's end, and 'Jaggis'/'Delhi'/'too little' were written 'Juggies'/'deli'/'two little' (the sounds were right). Round 2 (s03d-f, s09d-f, s10d, s13b): three new plans each for Gujral (/ɡʊʤəɹˈɑːl/, /ɡˈʊʤɹɑːl/, /ɡʊʤTˈɑːl/) and Peshawar (/pɛʃˈɑːwɑɹ/, /pAʃˈɑːvəɹ/, /pɛʃˈɑːwˌɔɹ/), s09/s10 as 'The Gujral family says' / 'The Jaggi family says', s10's 'not enough chicken', a crisper 'certain'. Round 2 (run 41228848394): Peshawar /pAʃˈɑːvəɹ/ was heard 'p eɪ ʃ ɑː v ɚ' (pay-SHAA-var; the w plans glided to 'aʊ w'); Gujral /ɡˈʊʤɹɑːl/ before 'family' (s09e) was heard 'ɡ ʊ dʒ ɹ ɑː l' and written 'Gujral' by large-v3, but after 'Kundan Lal' (s03e) still 'ɡ ə d ɹ ɑː l'; the schwa plan added a syllable ('Gujaral'), the flap made 'Gujjal'; certain /sˈɜɹtən/ was heard by both Whispers. Round 3: s03g (no comma after Gujral), s03h (secondary stress), s03k (the friends first).
